prospective.ranking_limit: Do not rank before independent source/truth acceptance and prospective runtime freeze

semantics.clinical_scope: Research source-fidelity evaluation only, not clinical advice or evidence endorsement.
semantics.components: Two or three explicit reviewer-request components, written before any ranking; no expected answer values injected into component text.
semantics.context_anchors: Exact source limitations and hard-negative context, never scored as sufficient support. Article-scoped null does not assert universal absence of evidence.
semantics.offsets: Half-open Unicode code-point offsets in independently reconstructed original canonical text.
semantics.support_sets: Sufficient OR alternatives; each alternative is a necessary AND of exact own-source spans. All requested components and quantitative qualifiers must be supported. Alternative cardinality is not an answerability score.
